messages:
nina: Heads up — API reference has an inconsistent example for POST /v1/embeddings. The request body in the page shows:
```json
{
  "embeddings": ["the quick brown fox"],
  "model": "rwd-embedding-001"
}
```
but the real endpoint expects `input` (string or array) not `embeddings`. That mismatch is causing confusion in SDK examples and a support ticket.

jordan: oh dang, good catch. Which page exactly? link?

nina: docs/reference/embeddings.md (I can paste the permalink in a sec). Search for the JSON example under "Request body" — it's the first example block.

sam: do we have a canonical shape for the request body across languages? iirc it's `{"input": ... , "model": "..."}` and embeddings-specific options like `context` are optional.

maya: @nina can you open a quick docs PR to swap the key to `input` and add an inline note about the SDK parameter name? I can review.

nina: created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2387 — changes the example to:
```json
{
  "input": ["the quick brown fox"],
  "model": "rwd-embedding-001"
}
```
Also added a short migration note: "If you previously used `embeddings` in requests, switch to `input` — SDKs accept `input`."

dev_docs_bot: build status for PR #2387 — FAILED — docs-linter: example-body-key-order (error). See CI details: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/2387

jordan: linter error sounds fixable. Probably expects alphabetical keys or validated schema. Nina, can you run the linter locally (`make docs-lint`) and push a small formatting fix?

nina: will run now. also realized the Python snippet still used `embeddings=` kwarg in the client call. I'll update Python/JS/Go snippets in the same PR.

lucas: quick note for SDK maintainers: when updating examples, make sure the Go client example uses `client.Embeddings(ctx, EmbeddingsParams{Input: []string{"..."}})` (we previously had `Embeddings: []string{}` in the snippet). I can drop a follow-up commit to the SDK repo if you want.

sam: +1 on keeping SDK and docs in sync. If you update the docs, please add a one-line migration note in the top of the embeddings page and in the changelog (docs/changelog.md). That will reduce churn in support.

maya: I reviewed #2387 — comment left with the linter fix suggestion. Also flagged the example to add `content-type: application/json` remark for curl examples.

nina: pushed fixes: formatting + updated Python/JS/Go snippets + added migration note + changelog entry. CI re-run queued.

dev_docs_bot: build status for PR #2387 — PASSED. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/docs/embeddings

jordan: nice. can someone confirm the preview page's examples render properly (code block language, copy buttons)? small UX issues have bitten us before.

maya: preview looks good on chrome and safari. copy button shows the full `curl` example and the JSON is valid.

lucas: i'll open a tiny SDK PR to align the Go snippet to the new docs shape and reference PR #2387.

nina: linked SDK PR in the embeddings page and removed the draft flag on #2387. ready for final review.

maya: LGTM, merging now. thanks everyone :tada:

sam: closing loop: support ticket owner notified, suggested client-side temporary workaround (transform `embeddings` -> `input`) included in the ticket thread.

nina: great, thanks. I'll watch for any post-merge regressions and follow up if needed.
